hints.title: Prefix XOR Cancellation
hints.text: A subarray nums[i..j] has bitwise exclusive-or equal to zero if and only if prefix_xor[j] equals prefix_xor[i-1].

hints.title: Earliest Occurrence Mapping
hints.text: Record the earliest index at which each running prefix exclusive-or sum is encountered.

hints.title: Span Maximization
hints.text: Upon seeing a recurring prefix exclusive-or value, the difference between current index and earliest index gives the maximum subarray length.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass prefix exclusive-or with hash map lookup.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all pairs (i, j) naively takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) memory for prefix exclusive-or map.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Map zero exclusive-or subarray condition to identical prefix exclusive-or states.
